title: User-Driven Value Alignment: Understanding Users’ Perceptions and Strategies for Addressing Biased and Discriminatory Statements in AI Companions
benchmark_measurement: The paper searched for user complaints about 'religion' as a type of discrimination when collecting data from social media. However, religious bias was not one of the six common types of discrimination that emerged from the analysis of the collected data, and therefore it was not measured or detailed in the findings.
findings: The paper did not report any specific findings related to religion. Although 'religion' was included as a keyword during the data collection phase for identifying discriminatory statements, it did not emerge as one of the six main themes of bias perceived by users, which were misogyny, LGBTQ+ bias, appearance bias, ableism, racism, and socioeconomic bias.
